en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a river and a lattice iron bridge in a natural landscape surrounded by trees, with mountains in the background. The front side contains printed and handwritten Swedish text, mentioning 'Erikslund. Parti från Borgsjö.' The reverse side includes a green Swedish stamp (5 öre), a postmark, and an address written in cursive Swedish.
